description: This Java class, CustomerPassword, defines a data entity for capturing customer password information, including validation rules and comparison constraints for password change operations.

classes.name: CustomerPassword
classes.description: A Java bean representing customer password data with validation annotations and cross-field validation for password confirmation.

methods.name: getCurrentPassword
methods.description: Returns the current password entered by the customer.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the new password provided by the customer.

methods.name: getCheckPassword
methods.description: Returns the repeated password for confirmation.
